plan.root_cause: The suggestion list items have tabindex='0', placing them in the tab order. When the list is open, pressing Tab moves focus into the first list item instead of skipping to the next form field.
plan.repair_strategy: Change the tabindex of list items from '0' to '-1' to remove them from the tab order while preserving ARIA roles and script-driven selection via arrow keys.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: With the list open, a Tab press will move focus to the next focusable element (the dietary input), meeting WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.3 Focus Order requirements.
functional_risks: Talkback users who previously relied on tabbing into list items may need to use arrow keys; however arrow-key navigation and aria-activedescendant remain functional.
verification_requirements: Verify that after typing 'Ber' in the city field, pressing Tab moves focus to the dietary input field.
Confirm that ArrowDown/ArrowUp still navigate suggestions and that Enter selects a highlighted suggestion.
Ensure the suggestion list closes when focus leaves the input (via Tab or blur).
Check that screen readers announce the currently selected suggestion via aria-activedescendant during arrow-key navigation.
